page.overview:
Who is H.I.S.S. Driver?

The Cobra H.I.S.S. Drivers are the original armored infantry personnel of Cobra. As tank operators, recruits are taken from a pool of the strongest Cobra Officers with the nastiest scruples when it comes to fighting in armored vehicles. Not only are they tank operators, they are also expected to have knowledge of operating F.A.N.G. helicopters and every NATO and G.I. Joe weapons.

Driver: These drivers are one rank above Cobra Officers, and can order troops into battle. They make-up the majority of Cobra's Armored Division (next to Track-Vipers, although they might be the same). They have red uniforms, blue chest-plates, and black boots and accessories.

Company Commander: They command a group of HISS Tanks and attached ground forces. They have blue uniforms, black chest-plates, black boots, and red accessories.

Battalion Commander: They command several groups of armored units, with one officer in charge of the whole Armored Division (see: Rip It). They have black uniforms and chest-plates, and blue boots and accessories.
